mobbin:ed6229f6-fa6d-413b-a6da-2edf7bb73.summary: The user shares one headline number (Revenue) from its box, creates a public snapshot link that expires, then opens or copies the link.
steps: Dashboard: Revenue, Burn, Expenses boxes; Customize; 3 months
Same boxes with updated totals; card more menu visible
Share metric window: snapshot note, Expires date, Create link
Link created: URL, open or paste, Expires date, Open in X / LinkedIn
steal: Each number has its own 'Share' option in the box's menu, instead of one export for the whole app (screen 2).
Before creating the link, the window explains that the chart is 'a snapshot in time' and asks for an expiry date (screen 4).
Once created, the link can be opened or copied, and its expiry date stays visible (screen 5).
The shared box has a legend for current, previous and average values (screens 1 to 2).
avoid: Buttons to post on X or LinkedIn in the share window have no place in digests for deans and faculty (screen 5).
mobbin:ed6229f6-fa6d-413b-a6da-2edf7bb73.fit: Reports: the best model for public digest links for deans that expire: one snapshot link per headline number. It is lighter than a live shared dashboard with filters.
